title: Componentwise linear monomial ideals
summary: Let $S=K[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ denote the polynomial ring in $n$ variables over a field $K$ with ${\rm deg} x_1=\cdots ={\rm deg} x_n = 1$ and ${\bf a} = (a_1,\ldots,a_n) \in {\mathbb Z}_{>0}^n$. Given a squarefree monomial $u=x_{i_1} \cdots x_{i_d}$ of $S$ with $1 \leq i_1 < \cdots < i_d \leq n$, we set $u^{[{\bf a}]}:=x_{i_1}^{a_{i_1}}\cdots x_{i_d}^{a_{i_d}}$. Let $I$ be a squarefree monomial ideal of $S$ and $G(I)$ its unique minimal set of monomial generators. We introduce the monomial ideal $I^{[{\bf a}]}$ with $G(I^{[{\bf a}]})=\{u^{[{\bf a}]} : u \in G(I)\}$. In the present paper,…
